nodes.description: ERC777.transfer: moves tokens from _msgSender() to recipient and calls tokensToSend before and tokensReceived after the balance update
ERC777.transferFrom: spends holder allowance and executes ERC777 sender/recipient hooks around the state changes
ERC777._send: internal transfer path invoking _callTokensToSend, _move and _callTokensReceived
ERC777._callTokensToSend: external call to the ERC1820 registered sender implementer before balances change
ERC777._callTokensReceived: external call to the ERC1820 registered recipient implementer after balances change
ERC777._mint: increases total supply and recipient balance then calls tokensReceived hook
ERC777._burn: calls tokensToSend hook before decreasing balance and total supply
ERC777._move: performs the actual balance subtraction/addition and emits Sent/Transfer
SkaleToken.mint: privileged mint restricted to SkaleManager, enforces the CAP supply limit
SkaleToken._callTokensToSend: nonReentrant override of the ERC777 sender hook dispatch
SkaleToken._callTokensReceived: nonReentrant override of the ERC777 recipient hook dispatch
SkaleToken._beforeTokenTransfer: blocks transfers of locked tokens by querying TokenState
SkaleManager.getBounty: validates node ownership and reward time then pays and mints bounty
SkaleManager.tokensReceived: ERC777 recipient hook that creates a schain from userData
SkaleManager._payBounty: mints SKL to the Distributor through an external IMintableToken call
Distributor.withdrawBounty: timelock checked withdrawal of earned bounty to an arbitrary destination
Distributor.tokensReceived: ERC777 hook that decodes validatorId and distributes the minted bounty
Distributor._distributeBounty: splits amount into validator fee and bounty and records them per month
Punisher.slash: privileged slashing entry that confiscates delegations of a validator
Punisher.forgive: admin function reducing the locked (slashed) amount of a holder
Punisher.handleSlash: increases the locked amount of a holder, callable by DelegationController
DelegationController.delegate: creates a delegation proposal after multiple validator checks
DelegationController.confiscate: applies a slashing reducing coefficient to a validator stake
DelegationController.processAllSlashes: public replay of pending slashing events for a holder
TokenLaunchManager.retrieve: transfers approved tokens to the caller then locks them for proof-of-use
TokenLaunchManager.approveTransfer: seller-only allocation of token amounts
TokenLaunchLocker.lock: increases the locked token amount of a holder
TokenLaunchLocker.getAndUpdateLockedAmount: timestamp-dependent proof-of-use unlock decision
TokenState.getAndUpdateLockedAmount: sums locked amounts from every registered locker via external calls
Address.sendValue: forwards all gas to a recipient with a low level call
Migrations.upgrade: casts an arbitrary address to Migrations and calls it, owner restricted
OwnableUpgradeSafe.transferOwnership: onlyOwner transfer of contract ownership
SkaleDKG.broadcast: node submits verification vector and key shares; uses block.timestamp for startAlrightTimestamp
SkaleDKG._finalizeSlashing: rotates the bad node and slashes it through Punisher and SlashingTable
Precompiled.bn256Pairing: staticcall to precompile 8 for pairing verification
KeyStorage.adding: accumulates public key contributions in G2
Nodes.createNode: registers a new node for a validator, SkaleManager only
NodeRotation.selectNodeToGroup: pseudo-random node selection using blockhash
SchainsInternal._generateGroup: pseudo-random group generation using blockhash and schainId
Pricing.adjustPrice: timestamp gated price recalculation based on total load and capacity
Bounty.getBounty: computes the reward amount from stage pool and time based formulas
DelegationController.requestUndelegation: removes a delegation from all accounting structures
SkaleDKG.complaint: node complains about another node, time limited by COMPLAINT_TIMELIMIT
SkaleDKG.response: accused node answers a complaint with a decrypted share
SlashingTable.setPenalty: owner-only configuration of slashing penalties
Pricing.checkAllNodes: refreshes the cached number of online nodes, public entry point
Low level call forwarding all remaining gas and value to a caller supplied payable recipient
External invocation of IERC777Sender.tokensToSend on an ERC1820 registered, attacker controlled implementer
External invocation of IERC777Recipient.tokensReceived on an ERC1820 registered, attacker controlled implementer
Assembly staticcall to precompile 5 (bigModExp) whose success is only checked by a require
Assembly staticcall to precompile 8 (bn256 pairing) with unchecked precompile output semantics
External IERC20.transfer call to the SkaleToken contract whose return value must be trusted
External IMintableToken.mint call that re-enters the ERC777 token and its recipient hooks
Loop of external ILocker.getAndUpdateLockedAmount calls inside TokenState, executable while token hooks run
Cross-contract calls to NodeRotation, SchainsInternal, Punisher and SlashingTable during slashing finalization
msg.sender: caller controlled account used for authorization and ownership decisions
block.timestamp: miner influenced time source used for locks, reward and price calculations
tx.origin: origin account, phishable identity used in authorization checks
ERC777._balances: token balances mapping mutated by mint, burn and move
ERC777._totalSupply: total token supply mutated by mint and burn
ERC777._allowances: ERC20 allowance mapping spent by transferFrom
ReentrancyGuard._status: guard flag written by the nonReentrant modifier
SkaleToken.CAP: maximum token supply enforced by mint
TokenLaunchManager.approved: per holder approved token amount
TokenLaunchManager._totalApproved: aggregate approved amount checked against the balance
TokenLaunchManager.tokenLaunchIsCompleted: flag gating approvals and enabling retrieval
Punisher._locked: slashed (locked) amounts per holder
ContractManager.contracts: name hash to implementation address registry used by all contracts
OwnableUpgradeSafe._owner: privileged owner address
DelegationController.delegations: array of all delegation records used as delegation ids
SkaleDKG.channels: DKG channel state including n and start timestamps
KeyStorage._schainsPublicKeys: group public keys finalized by DKG
Nodes.nodes: array of node records including status and validatorId
SchainsInternal.schainsGroups: node index group membership per schain
Bounty._stagePool: remaining bounty tokens for the current stage
TokenLaunchLocker._locked: proof-of-use locked token amounts per holder
Pricing.price: current schain price
Pricing.lastUpdated: timestamp of the last price adjustment
amount: token amount transferred or minted
recipient: destination address of a token transfer
delegationId: index into the delegations array
priceChange: computed price delta in Pricing.adjustPrice
load: total network load computed from schains
random: blockhash derived pseudo random value used for node selection
validatorId: validator identifier being slashed or delegated to
bounty: reward amount minted and paid out
to: destination address provided by the withdrawer
numberOfRewards: remaining reward periods used in the bounty denominator

edges.reason: transfer reads _msgSender() as the from address
transferFrom reads _msgSender() as the spender
mint is restricted by the allow(SkaleManager) modifier which compares msg.sender to the registered contract
slash is restricted by allow(SkaleDKG) checked against msg.sender
forgive is restricted by the onlyAdmin modifier which inspects msg.sender
retrieve looks up approved[_msgSender()] to decide the payout
approveTransfer is guarded by onlySeller which evaluates _msgSender()
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner comparing _owner to _msgSender()
Migrations.upgrade is guarded by the restricted modifier checking msg.sender == owner
setPenalty is guarded by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender
createNode binds the node to the caller supplied from address
delegate records msg.sender as the delegation holder
processAllSlashes is public and processes slashing state for a caller supplied holder
getBounty compares now against the reward period and last reward date
adjustPrice requires now > lastUpdated + COOLDOWN_TIME and uses now for timeSkipped
withdrawBounty requires now >= launchTimestamp + BOUNTY_LOCKUP_MONTHS
getBounty derives the stage and reward counts from now
proof-of-use unlock compares the calculated lock end time with now
broadcast records startAlrightTimestamp = now and complaints depend on block.timestamp
transfer calls the tokensToSend hook before balances are updated
transfer delegates the balance update to _move
transfer calls the tokensReceived hook after balances are updated
transferFrom calls tokensToSend before allowance and balances change
transferFrom moves tokens through _move
transferFrom calls tokensReceived at the end of the transfer path
_send dispatches the sender hook before moving balances
_send updates balances through _move
_send dispatches the recipient hook after moving balances
_burn calls tokensToSend before reducing balance and total supply
_mint calls tokensReceived after increasing total supply and balance
SkaleToken.mint delegates the supply update to ERC777._mint
the SkaleToken override invokes the super implementation under nonReentrant
the SkaleToken override invokes the super implementation under nonReentrant
the nonReentrant modifier writes the _status guard around the hook call
the nonReentrant modifier writes the _status guard around the hook call
_beforeTokenTransfer asks TokenState for the currently locked amount
_beforeTokenTransfer compares balanceOf(from) with locked + tokenId
_callTokensToSend performs an external call into an ERC1820 registered implementer
_callTokensReceived performs an external call into an ERC1820 registered implementer
sendValue forwards all gas and value to the caller supplied recipient
_payBounty mints through an external call that re-enters the ERC777 token and Distributor hook
withdrawBounty transfers SKL tokens out through an external ERC20 call
retrieve transfers SKL tokens to msg.sender through an external ERC20 call
TokenState loops over every locker performing external calls while token hooks may be executing
_finalizeSlashing performs several cross-contract calls including Punisher.slash
bn256Pairing issues an assembly staticcall to precompile 8
broadcast stores verification data into KeyStorage
_finalizeSlashing slashes the faulty node through Punisher
getBounty pays the computed amount through _payBounty
Distributor.tokensReceived decodes userData and distributes the bounty
slash confiscates validator stake in the DelegationController
forgive subtracts the forgiven amount from the _locked mapping
handleSlash adds the penalty to the _locked mapping
processAllSlashes forwards accumulated penalties to Punisher.handleSlash
confiscate reduces the recorded delegation amounts
requestUndelegation modifies delegation records and accounting structures
delegate queries TokenState for the forbidden-for-delegation amount
approveTransfer adds the value to the approved mapping
retrieve zeroes the approved amount of the caller
lock adds the amount to the _locked mapping
getAndUpdateLockedAmount reads and clears the _locked mapping
mint compares amount with CAP.sub(totalSupply())
_mint increases the recipient balance
_burn decreases the holder balance
_move subtracts from and adds to the balances mapping
transferFrom subtracts the spent amount from the allowance
adjustPrice stores lastUpdated = now, creating a timestamp dependency
adjustPrice adds or subtracts priceChange from the price
getBounty subtracts the bounty from the stage pool
upgrade casts a caller supplied address to Migrations and calls it
KeyStorage.adding accumulates the group public key
createNode pushes a new record into the nodes array
selectNodeToGroup adds the selected node to the schain group
_generateGroup writes the generated group into schainsGroups
the amount parameter is applied to balances during the transfer
the recipient parameter receives the transferred tokens
delegationId indexes the delegations array during undelegation
priceChange is derived from loadDiff, timeSkipped and the current price
load from _getTotalLoad participates in the overload comparison
random selects the node index inserted into the new group
validatorId identifies the validator whose delegations are confiscated
the bounty amount is minted to the Distributor
to is the destination address of the bounty transfer
numberOfRewards is used in the bounty division denominator

normalization_plan.reason: amount is a value parameter only meaningful for the transfer it feeds
recipient has no independent semantics outside the transfer destination
delegationId is purely an index used by the undelegation routine
priceChange is a temporary computed inside the price adjustment arithmetic
load is a temporary result of _getTotalLoad consumed by the price formula
random is a temporary pseudo random value used only for group generation
validatorId is an identifier argument consumed by the slashing routine
bounty is a temporary amount passed to the external mint unsafe operation
to is only the destination of the outgoing token transfer
numberOfRewards is an intermediate used in the bounty arithmetic
